# English Learning App

![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-3178C6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)
![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-61DAFB?logo=react&logoColor=black)
![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-339933?logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)
![PostgreSQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/PostgreSQL-4169E1?logo=postgresql&logoColor=white)

**Learn English while studying anything else.** Pick a topic, get an English text about it generated by the Claude API, tap the words you don't know, and get an English definition plus a PT-BR translation for each one. Saved words become flashcards with light spaced repetition.

🔗 **Live demo:** https://learning-english-words-liart.vercel.app

## How it works

1. Create an account or log in.
2. Enter a topic title and description (limit: 1 new topic per day).
3. The backend asks the Claude API for an English text about it.
4. Click the words you don't know; they appear in a side list where you can remove them.
5. On confirm, the backend asks Claude for each word's English definition and PT-BR translation in a fixed format, and stores everything linked to your account.

## Flashcards

The **Flashcards** tab reviews the words you've saved with light spaced repetition:

- Every saved word has a `retention_level` (0 = new / don't know, 1 = unsure, 2–5 = growing confidence) and a `next_review_at` that schedules its next appearance.
- The card front shows the word; "Reveal translation" (or clicking the card) shows definition and translation. A button plays the pronunciation (Web Speech API).
- Rating: 🟢 **Learned** raises the level and postpones the review; 🟡 **Unsure** sets an intermediate level (back in ~1 day); 🔴 **Don't know** resets the level and re-queues the word at the end of the current session.
- The queue (`GET /api/flashcards/queue`) returns only due cards, one per distinct word, filtered by the selected translation language.

## Authentication and security

- Email + password accounts; passwords hashed with `bcrypt`, never stored in plain text.
- Sessions are `httpOnly` cookies backed by a `sessions` table, revocable on logout.
- Repeated failed logins temporarily lock that email (5 attempts / 15 min, progressive lockout). Error messages are generic and never reveal whether an email exists.
- Daily topic limit enforced on the backend.

## Tech stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Frontend | React, TypeScript, Vite |
| Backend | Node.js, Express, TypeScript |
| Database | PostgreSQL (Docker locally, Supabase in production) |
| LLM | Claude API (`@anthropic-ai/sdk`) |
| Deploy | Vercel (frontend), Railway/Render (backend) |

## Running locally

With Docker:

```bash
cp .env.example .env     # add your Anthropic API key
docker compose up --build
```

- Frontend: http://localhost:3000
- Backend health check: http://localhost:3001/health

Migrations run automatically on first start (`backend/src/db/migrations`).

Without Docker:

```bash
# backend
cd backend && npm install
cp .env.example .env     # set DATABASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
npm run dev

# frontend (another terminal)
cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev
```

## Deployment note

Frontend (Vercel) and backend (Railway/Render) live on different domains, but the session cookie needs to behave as same-origin. Instead of `SameSite=None` cross-site cookies, `frontend/vercel.json` proxies `/api/*` to the backend through Vercel rewrites, so the browser only ever sees the `*.vercel.app` domain. Set `VITE_API_URL=""` on Vercel and replace `__BACKEND_URL__` in `vercel.json` with the real backend URL.

## Out of scope for now

Email verification on sign-up and "forgot password" by email (they would need an email provider).
